blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senator Panfilo Lacson on Friday disputed Vice President Sara Duterte’s remark that corruption is a “progressive disorder” deeply embedded in the government’s DNA. In a social media post, Lacson described Duterte’s statement as “sweeping,” adding that corruption may exist across the bureaucracy but should not be used to characterize all public officials. “I beg to disagree. Such a statement is far too sweeping. Corruption may exist across the bureaucracy, but it does not define everyone,” Lacson said.
